messages:
June (Design): quick design review note 1: the tool-calling panel in Playground feels crowded when you tab into it. keyboard users end up landing on the Close X and cant reach the shortcuts or argument inputs easily. Arif (DevEx): thanks. is this the new compact layout we shipped last week? can you paste repro steps? June (Design): open a function def -> click "Run" -> press Tab twice. focus lands on Close, then cycles. expected: Tab should move into the tools list or the first argument input. Maya (Frontend): yep thats focus-lock + initialFocus behavior. quick solution: set initialFocus to the first tabbable in the panel body and implement a roving-tabindex pattern for the tool list so arrows move between tools. Leo (A11y): roving-tabindex + role=listbox/option would be ideal. also add a small sr-only instruction attached to the panel header: "Use Tab to enter tools, Arrow keys to navigate, Enter to invoke." ensure Esc closes and focus returns to the invoking control. Ruth (PM): product constraint: keep the preview lightweight and avoid auto-opening mobile keyboards. if initialFocus would trigger the keyboard on small screens, switch to a bottom-sheet without autofocus. Maya (Frontend): plan: desktop -> side panel with initialFocus on tool-list container; mobile -> bottom-sheet with no autofocus. add aria-describedby to header pointing to sr-only hint. Arif (DevEx): can we also fix run-history truncation? function names currently break mid-word in compact rows. suggestion: ellipsize at word boundaries and show tooltip on hover/focus. June (Design): yes please. also micro-copy tweak: change header from "Preview invocation" to "Invocation preview" + tiny hint icon that shows the short keyboard reminder on hover/focus. Leo (A11y): icon ok if keyboardable and linked with aria-describedby. SR should read the full instruction from the sr-only node. Maya (Frontend): i'll add unit + storybook tests demonstrating keyboard navigation. small code example I'll include in PR: ```html
  • Summarize
  • HTTP Call

Use Tab to enter tools; Arrow keys to navigate; Enter to run; Esc to close.

``` CI-Bot: added e2e tasks PLG-KEY-99 (panel focus) and PLG-KEY-100 (roving list). Arif (DevEx): implementation plan: 1) change initialFocus + aria attrs (small PR), 2) storybook + unit tests (Maya), 3) QA keyboard pass (CI-Bot), 4) ship behind FF for a11y lab validation. Ruth (PM): prioritize keyboard + screen-reader fixes; run-history truncation can follow if timeline tight. June (Design): thanks all 389 please ping when PR is ready for copy polish. Maya (Frontend): opening PR tonight and will tag @Leo and @Arif for review.
